title: Retrying a channel post with one idempotency key does not duplicate
description:
As a household member, I want retrying a posted message with the same Idempotency-Key to return the original row and turn, so a dropped HTTP response does not enqueue a second bot turn.

Feature: Channels and the message store

Scenario: Retrying a post with the same idempotency key does not duplicate
  Given an empty control plane
  And tenant "anthus" user "ryan" has a bot named "Researcher"
  And tenant "anthus" user "ryan" has opened a channel with bots:
    | Researcher |
  When user "ryan" of tenant "anthus" posts "hello" addressed to bot "Researcher" on the channel with idempotency key "retry-1"
  And user "ryan" of tenant "anthus" posts "hello" addressed to bot "Researcher" on the channel with idempotency key "retry-1"
  Then the channel has 1 message
  And bot "Researcher" has 1 pending turn with required capabilities:
    | cpu |

The key is stored on the messaging table so a recycled Front Door Lambda still sees it.

Not included: staging, production, Fargate, Safari.
